description: Audit a SaaS lifecycle email using the 7-point Decision Friction Model and return a structured conversion diagnosis.

audience.description: Optional description of the intended email audience.

body.description: The full email body, including its copy and calls to action.

desired_action.description: Optional action the sender wants the reader to take.

email_type.description: Optional lifecycle context, such as "trial onboarding", "changelog", or "re-engagement".

preview_text.description: Optional preview or preheader text shown beside the subject.

subject.description: The email subject line to audit.

name: audit_email

audit_record_id.description: Identifier of the stored upstream audit record.

audits_remaining.description: Number of audits remaining after this request.

audits_used.description: Number of audits used after this request.

changes.description: Changes made by the audit service.

cta_diagnosis_direction.description: Diagnosis and direction for the call to action.

cta_exact_line.description: Exact CTA line from the email, or an explicit no-CTA statement.

cta_pattern.description: The Decision Friction Model pattern that best describes the CTA.

cta_pattern_definition.description: Plain-language definition of the CTA pattern.

cta_rewrite.description: A specific rewritten CTA for this email.

cta_weakness.description: Concrete explanation of why this CTA is weak.

message.description: Friendly usage or next-step message when no diagnosis is returned.

original_score.description: Original structural email score from 0 to 10 for members.

original_subject.description: The original email subject sent for rebuilding.

primary_friction_pattern.description: The main Decision Friction Model pattern found.

primary_friction_pattern_definition.description: Plain-language definition of the primary pattern.

primary_friction_pattern_evidence.description: Exact problematic phrase from this email showing the primary pattern.

primary_friction_pattern_impact.description: Concrete reason the primary pattern can reduce response or conversion.

raw_response.description: The upstream diagnosis when it cannot be safely parsed into validated fields.

rebuilt_score.description: Rebuilt structural email score from 0 to 10 for members.

recommended_structural_change.description: The highest-impact structural change to make.

result_type.description: Whether the diagnosis was parsed into validated model fields.

secondary_friction_pattern.description: A secondary Decision Friction Model pattern, if present.

secondary_friction_pattern_definition.description: Plain-language definition of the secondary pattern, when present.

secondary_friction_pattern_evidence.description: Exact problematic phrase from this email showing the secondary pattern.

secondary_friction_pattern_impact.description: Concrete reason the secondary pattern can reduce response or conversion.

short_diagnosis.description: Brief explanation of the core structural conversion friction.

structured_fixes.description: Structured email fixes returned by the audit service.

upgrade_url.description: Upgrade URL returned by the audit service.

variants.description: Alternative rebuild variants returned by the audit service.

title: Audit Email
